FAQs about the Fazaa Program in UAE

Fazaa is a social initiative launched to support UAE nationals with various benefits, discounts, and community services.

Yes, it’s mainly targeted at employees of the Ministry of Interior and other participating government entities.

Basic membership is usually free, but premium services might come with additional charges.
